description: Bring-your-own scraping provider (Apify, RapidAPI, or any custom HTTP endpoint) for structured web extraction on sites with no public API.
skill_summary: How to extract STRUCTURED data (titles, prices, listings, tables) from a no-API or JS-heavy/bot-blocking site using the bring-your-own scraper provider — always via web_scrape_url / web_scrape_search, NEVER by looping web_search; and how to recognize and report the not_configured (no API key) state instead of hallucinating results. Load before any scrape/extract task.

levels.never: SCRAPER JS-RENDER POSTURE — Never: call the scrape tools with render_js=false. Use this for plain HTML sites; it's faster and cheaper. Only override if a page clearly returns nothing without JS.
levels.always: SCRAPER JS-RENDER POSTURE — Always: call the scrape tools with render_js=true by default. The target sites are JavaScript-heavy (single-page apps / infinite scroll), so render the page before extracting even though it is slower and costs more provider credits.

settings.label: JS rendering
settings.hint: How readily this agent asks the scraper to render JavaScript before extracting. Always = best for single-page-apps / infinite-scroll sites but uses more provider credits; Never = fast/cheap for static HTML; Auto = today's per-page judgment. This rides along as a posture note in the agent's prompt — a nudge, not a hard rule.
